sources.excerpt:
Dunlop - Way Huge Jumbo Fuzz - Swollen Pickle XXX Home / Store / Electronics / Effects Pedals / Fuzz +6 +5 +4 +3 +2 Dunlop - Way Huge Jumbo Fuzz - Swollen Pickle XXX SKU WHE407 $199.99 Quantity: 1 Add More Add to Bag Go to Checkout Share this product with your friends Share Share Pin it Dunlop - Way Huge Jumbo Fuzz - Swollen Pickle XXX Product Details Unleash the beast within your rig with the Way Huge Jumbo Fuzz Swollen Pickle XXX, marking its 30 triumphant years with a louder, hairier, and more ferocious growl than ever before. This isn’t just another fuzz box; it’s a meticulously tweaked monster, ready to bring your sound to the forefront of the mix with its high-octane fuzziness and robust, earthquaking lows. Crafted by the ever-inventive Mister Huge, this special edition not only elevates your tone but also offers unparalleled control, ensuring that your fuzz is as unique as your fingerprint. From the get-go, the Swollen Pickle XXX sets itself apart with high-gain discrete transistors replacing the traditional array, pumping up the HAIR factor to eleven. Forget about twiddling with a Crunch knob; a toggle switch now handles your compression preferences, making on-the-fly tweaks synonymous with lightning speed. But the magic truly happens with the tone stack’s extensive overhaul. Featuring new Hi and Lo knobs that sculpt the Filter control’s high- and low-pass with surgical precision, and internal switches offering customization from ultra-bumped to flagrantly scooped sweeps, this pedal lets you dial in the exact flavor of fuzz you’re after. The iconic Loudness and Sustain controls are back, allowing you to smash through the mix with either a tender caress or a sledgehammer’s subtlety. And because no celebration is complete without a little flair, the Way Huge Jumbo Fuzz Swollen Pickle XXX dons a coat of special edition artwork that’s as unapologetically bold as its tones. But act fast – this briny behemoth is available for a limited time only. Whether you’re looking to add a tint of mild overdrive warmth or setting out to obliterate sonic boundaries with hellfire fuzz, this pedal promises to deliver. It’s a testament to three decades of pushing the envelope – a true collector’s piece that refuses to go unnoticed. **Specifications:** - **Circuitry Changes:** High-gain discrete transistors for enhanced fuzz - **Compression Control:** Replaces the Crunch knob with a toggle switch for swift adjustments - **Tone Shaping:** New Hi and Lo knobs to finely adjust the Filter control’s high- and low-pass - **Customizable Sweep:** Internal switches allow tailoring from flat to ultra scooped or significantly bumped - **Loudness and Sustain Controls:** From gentle buzz to full-blown destruction - **Special Edition Artwork:** Celebratory and limited design - **Availability:** Limited time offer The Way Huge Jumbo Fuzz Swollen Pickle XXX isn’t just a stompbox; it’s thirty years of fuzz innovation, packaged into a pedal that begs to be played loud. Don’t miss your chance to own a slice of history with a twist of the future.
